scripts.dev: npm run build -w @cents/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @cents/contracts" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cents/contracts && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @cents/contracts && npm run build -w @cents/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @cents/contracts && npm run build -w @cents/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run start:api" "npm run start:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cents/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:production: npm run build && CENTS_TEST_PRODUCTION=1 npm test
scripts.test:api: npm run build:api && CENTS_TEST_API_ONLY=1 CENTS_TEST_PRODUCTION=1 playwright test tests/api-*.spec.ts
